objective: Make Naya Power executable, fail-closed at consequential execution boundaries, and continuously self-tested at the live ChatGPT action boundary.
why: Review of the executable gateway found that an action could declare a protected baseline different from the claimed execution start head. That would weaken source-state integrity, so the gateway was hardened before live acceptance work.
changes: Gateway now rejects a protected baseline that does not equal the claimed execution start head.
Authorization output explicitly distinguishes side-effect authorization from side-effect execution.
Runner-tested the complete runtime continuity workflow again before merge.

observations.failure: Sparse checkout attempted to materialize an unrelated legacy repository filename beyond the runner filesystem limit.

observations.result: Kernel 5/5; Orchestrator 3/3; ChatGPT host adapter 4/4; Live host bridge 3/3; Activation gate passed.
Execution controller, risk engine, model/tool gateway, activation gate, and all prior runtime checks passed with cleanup.
Protected-baseline hardening plus full runtime continuity passed every substantive test and cleanup step; job conclusion success.

learning: Do not trust model-declared risk; derive risk from action metadata and fail closed on mismatch.
A consequential action needs an explicit execution claim before the tool side effect is authorized.
The authorization baseline must be bound to the exact source state from which execution was claimed.
Execution must have an explicit observation and evidence path before VERIFIED or HANDED_OFF.
Sparse checkout must use a non-cone runtime-only pattern in this repository because of the unrelated legacy long filename.
Integration tests are valuable because they found a real continuation field mismatch that lower-level tests did not expose.
Naya Power does not claim magical interception of hidden model inference; ChatGPT remains the reasoning host and the runtime governs the executable action boundary.
next_action: Use the actual NayaNET Intelligent Hub source as the first real acceptance workload; inspect source of truth, generate candidate actions, pass the selected consequential action through claim/gateway, execute with the authorized host tool, independently verify the exact outcome, record a receipt, promote the learning, and continue.
